card.name: Chennu Nalike
card.tagline: Tulu Mera-community post-harvest ritual dance of Suggi
card.profile: Chennu Nalike is an ancient traditional folk-ritual art practised by the Mera (Moger/Mogera) community of Tulu Nadu, an indigenous, matrilineally organised people of Kasaragod (Kerala) and the Mangalore, Udupi and Coorg districts of Karnataka (Wikipedia). Performed at night after the harvest in the Tulu month of Suggi (around February-March), it begins on Suggi Punnam (full moon) and lasts three to nine days as decided by the community head (Wikipedia). It features two characters, Chennu and Koraga; the Chennu wears a woman's costume with a Sampige flower on the head, while men and women provide background music and sing Paddanas (Tuluva oral epics) (Wikipedia).
card.insight: The Mera belong to the body of Tuluva ritual specialists (alongside Nalike, Parava and Pambada communities) who serve as mediums in Bhuta Kola spirit worship, situating Chennu Nalike within the wider Dravidian ritual cosmology of Tulu Nadu (Wikipedia, Buta Kola).

observation.setting: An indoor or covered stage with a red stage floor and a backdrop of gathered vertical drapes in pink, yellow, and white, with a banner displaying Kannada text.
observation.dancers: A group of seven dancers, mixing women and men/youth, performing together as a group.
observation.formation_and_space: Dancers move across the stage in loose lines, semi-circles, and sometimes kneeling in a tight cluster.
observation.posture: Upright yet slightly bent knees with weight shifting dynamically as they step and turn.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping and stamping to the beat, alternating feet with quick weight transfers and pivoting turns.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held at waist or shoulder height, occasionally gesturing outward or raised overhead; hands are generally open or loosely cupped.
observation.hips_and_torso: Subtle side-to-side torso movement and slight hip engagement corresponding to the rhythmic stepping.
observation.partnering: None; independent group dancing without physical contact between partners.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Features low-level squatting/kneeling formations, graceful turns, and energetic stepping across the stage.
observation.costume_and_props: Dancers wear dark wrapped skirts or trousers, light-colored tops, headbands or caps, and beaded necklaces.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement details and precise weight distribution are obscured by low-resolution video sampling.

signature_moments.what: Dancers travel across the stage in a line with vigorous side-to-side stepping and coordinated arm swings.
Dancers stamp rhythmically on the spot while clapping and turning in unison.
Dancers drop gracefully into a low kneeling position while extending their arms outward.
